text:
andrew: Quick heads-up — after the Confluence -> KB export I spotted a bunch of broken fragment anchors and a few missing screenshot crops. Can people dibs ownership on pages they touched? I ran `rg -n --hidden --glob '!node_modules' '#[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' docs/` and found ~14 hits. TL;DR: need owners to confirm redirects or update anchors.

jess: :raised_hand: I'll take the runtime/compilation docs I touched last month. Which list did you run?

andrew: used `rg -n --hidden --glob '!node_modules' '#[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' docs/` — script attached. Example broken: `docs/runtime/kv-cache.md` links to `#cache-behavior` but header is `## KV cache behavior`.

docs-bot: Automated link-scan: 14 fragment mismatches, 3 image 403s. Full report: https://internal.kb/reports/1758023333 (persisted as artifacts).

sam: I can fix two images in onboarding screenshots (staging CDN returned 403). Filing a quick PR — pinging @maria for alt-text check.

maria: Thanks @sam — can you add the original screenshot crop as fallback in the PR? Also include the exact cdn path so we can rehost if needed (cc: infra-team).

andrew: Filed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/482 — small `sed` to align anchors + added a tiny test in `ci/link-check.sh` that fails the job on fragment mismatches. PTAL @jess @maria.

jess: LGTM. left one nit about code fence formatting. :thumbsup:

maria: approving once CI passes. @andrew can you add a one-liner in the release note about this small KB tidy so customer-facing changelogs don't regress?

andrew: will do. thx all — aim to merge by EOD, will update the scan report after merge (and ping this thread).
